title: B.Tech undergraduate eligibility
content: Bennett University's current eligibility page states that B.Tech Computer Science Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electronics and Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Engineering Physics generally require Class XII with Physics and Mathematics plus another third subject, with a minimum of 55% marks; the third subject should not be vocational. B.Tech Artificial Intelligence is listed with a minimum of 60% marks and the required Physics and Mathematics combination. Selection for these B.Tech programs is based on the Class XII Best of 3 subjects score with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects and the highest-scoring eligible third subject.
